messages.subject: Emma | Global Mining Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Hudson,

I am sharing my profile for senior mining and resources leadership mandates across the GCC and other international markets.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your mining executive-search background, including prior work recruiting expatriate professionals for First Quantum Minerals in Africa, makes your remit especially relevant to my next move. I am targeting internationally mobile leadership mandates where government interface, sustainability, stakeholder trust and country-level execution are central.

My target roles include Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track positions across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership.

I have attached a mining-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, while I remain open to strong global mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
